name: tracker-native-piped-json
goal: Native harness tracker --json output reaches a piped reader whole (no truncation at the 64 KiB pipe buffer), so tracker-alert.py and agents can parse list --flagged --json after the cutover

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Failing: native 'harness tracker list --flagged --json' read through a pipe stops at 64 KiB multiples (294912/262145/360449/98304 of 418376 bytes against a staged hub copy, 01:17Z); file redirect is whole. Expected: whole JSON for piped readers such as ~/chief-of-staff/bin/tracker-alert.py. Repro: compiled harness cf47b4ea37 against a native hub rehearsal copy.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing piped-JSON case in test/cli-output.e2e.test.ts covers 'units graph' only, which goes through the commander path after pipedOutput(). The tracker fast path in runCli returned before pipedOutput(), and the native tracker tests (tracker-node e2e) read short outputs, so none crossed 64 KiB through a pipe. Added: native tracker case with a loopback API fixture (test/support/trackerNativeJsonFixture.ts) returning >256 KiB.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
